name: Computer Vision
description: Images as data, classical features and geometry, CNN-based recognition, detection, segmentation and 3D vision.

nodes.name: Digital images
nodes.desc: Pixels, channels and colour spaces, and images as arrays you can compute on.

nodes.name: Image filtering
nodes.desc: Convolution, blurring, sharpening and denoising filters.

nodes.name: Edges & gradients
nodes.desc: Image gradients, Sobel and Canny edge detection.

nodes.name: Geometric transforms
nodes.desc: Affine transforms, homographies and image warping.

nodes.name: Keypoints & features
nodes.desc: Corner detection and descriptors such as Harris, SIFT and ORB.

nodes.name: Feature matching
nodes.desc: Matching descriptors and fitting models robustly with RANSAC.

nodes.name: Camera model
nodes.desc: The pinhole camera, intrinsics and extrinsics, and calibration.

nodes.name: Panorama stitcher
nodes.desc: Stitch overlapping photos into a panorama using features and homographies.

nodes.name: CNNs for images
nodes.desc: Convolutional networks for image classification and what their filters learn.

nodes.name: Modern backbones
nodes.desc: ResNet, EfficientNet and Vision Transformers as feature extractors.

nodes.name: Augmentation
nodes.desc: Flips, crops, colour jitter and mixing strategies to improve generalisation.

nodes.name: Transfer learning
nodes.desc: Fine-tuning pretrained backbones on small datasets.

nodes.name: Object detection
nodes.desc: Bounding boxes, anchors, one-stage and two-stage detectors, IoU and NMS.

nodes.name: Segmentation
nodes.desc: Semantic and instance segmentation with U-Net and Mask R-CNN style models.

nodes.name: Vision metrics
nodes.desc: Precision-recall, mAP and mIoU for detection and segmentation.

nodes.name: Train a detector
nodes.desc: Collect or adapt a labelled dataset and train and evaluate an object detector.

nodes.name: Stereo & depth
nodes.desc: Epipolar geometry, stereo matching and monocular depth estimation.

nodes.name: Motion & video
nodes.desc: Optical flow, object tracking and video models.

nodes.name: Vision-language models
nodes.desc: Vision transformers and joint image-text models such as CLIP.

nodes.name: Image generation
nodes.desc: Generative models for images, image editing and conditioning.
